ITEM 1 | Two rectangular flatbread-style pieces, golden-brown crust with darker browned spots on the edges, each about 9 cm long and 5 cm wide, sitting end to end in a stacked pair on the left side of the plate; the bases are firm with slight charring and the top is dotted with reddish-brown sauce, pale white melted cheese, and thin slivers of purple-red onion | 95

ITEM 2 | Reddish-brown tomato-style sauce spread in dabs across the flatbread surfaces and a thin smear trailing toward the olives, glossy and moist with slight sheen | 8

ITEM 3 | Pale white melted cheese layer, soft and slightly stretched, covering the middle of both flatbread pieces, about 6 cm by 4 cm each, with small pooled areas | 25

ITEM 4 | Thin slivers of purple-red onion, translucent edges, about 4 cm long, scattered across the cheese on both flatbread pieces | 4

ITEM 5 | Dark green herb leaves, one or two broad leaves with slightly wilted, matte surface, about 3 cm long, lying on top of the cheese near the upper flatbread piece | 2

ITEM 6 | Small dark reddish-brown whole olives, glossy and smooth-skinned, about 2 cm long each, seven pieces clustered in a loose group on the right side of the plate, dry-looking surface with slight sheen | 35
